name: Throw Off-Balance (Ex)
body:
Benefit: Once per day, when an adjacent creature attacks and misses a rogue with this talent , the rogue may force that creature to take a 5-foot step that does not provoke an attack of opportunity, which must end in a safe square adjacent to the rogue . That creature becomes flat-footed against one target of the rogue ’s choosing until the beginning of the rogue ’s next turn.
